title: Give the Backend Tests gate a real MySQL and Redis
goal: Make the required Backend Tests job run the testmysql and testredis tests instead of silently skipping them, and fail if the DSN or Redis address goes missing.

in: Add MySQL (UTC) and a generic Redis service to backend-tests
A workflow test that pins this so it cannot silently regress
out: Making the job slower than needed

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Operates official acquisition and assembly; adjusts only ops-owned inputs the rebuild cannot carry

commands: Hosted Backend Tests on this PR
runtimeEvidence: Hosted Linux run with the MySQL service

runtimeGap: Windows CGO go test -race ./... passed against isolated UTC MySQL and Redis on 81b8089e. 77 packages passed and 14 reported no test files. Deploy took 1434.715s.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend Tests on this PR runs the MySQL-backed tests and passes
Removing the DSN or the REQUIRED flag fails the workflow test
The server clock is UTC to match the DSN loc=UTC
risks: The job gets slower and may expose product tests that never ran in CI
humanGates: Gate-policy change: the maintainer authorized adding MySQL to CI on 2026-11-26 (the reply read as 补mysql).

closeout.scope: Added MySQL (UTC), generic Redis, and required connection guards to backend-tests. PR #227 Backend Tests passed on hosted Linux in 7m24s; a follow-up main run also passed. Workflow regression assertions now pin both services and UTC settings.
residuals: The earlier Windows ThreadSanitizer allocation error 87 did not recur in the full passing run.
The reviewed assertion hardening and this closeout are ready in the isolated local worktree; main contains the verified workflow from PR #227.
